mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id AS userId, t.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.character_id AS characterId, t.client_message_id AS clientMessageId, t.request_type AS requestType, COALESCE(t.channel,'') AS channel, COALESCE(t.model,'') AS model, t.status, t.trace_id AS traceId, DATE_FORMAT(t.queued_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS queuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(t.started_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(t.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, COALESCE(t.duration_ms,0) AS durationMs, COALESCE(t.error_message,t.error_code,'') AS errorMessage FROM app_generation_task t LEFT JOIN app_conversation c ON c.id=t.conversation_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status='GENERATING' THEN 0 WHEN t.status='QUEUED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status='QUEUED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS queued, SUM(CASE WHEN status='GENERATING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generating, SUM(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' AND queued_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedHour, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code LIKE '%TIMEOUT%' AND queued_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeoutHour FROM app_generation_task WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
